themeNote: A node's tone selects its theme: hero (gradient band: nav, hero, photo stack on shell A), surface (page tint below the band), light (flat white shells B/C and the auth shell E), app (legal app shell D, #000 text). The schema locks tone per (section, variant) to the variant's allowed tones; templates fix the exact tone per node.
